header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: room of Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA). When he greeted her with the words:

blocks.arabic_text: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ

blocks.text: She then asked, 'How did you find your wife? May Allaah bless you.' Rasulullaah ﷺ then went to each of his wives' rooms in turn. As he greeting them as he greeted Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA), they said to him what Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) had said. When Rasulullaah ﷺ returned to the room (of Hadhrat Zaynab (RA)), he found the three men still sitting there and talking. Because Rasulullaah ﷺ was extremely bashful, (rather than telling them to leave) he again walked off towards the room of Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA). I cannot recall whether it was someone else or I who informed him that the men had left. He then returned and his one foot was still on the threshold and the other outside when he dropped the curtain between himself and I and the verse of Hijaab was revealed." [^1]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) also reports that after Rasulullaah ﷺ had consummated his marriage to one of his wives, Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) (Hadhrat Anas (RA)'s mother) cooked some Hais [^2], placed it in a dish and instructed (Hadhrat Anas (RA)) saying, "Take this to Rasulullaah ﷺ and inform him that it is a little something from us." This occurred during times when the Sahabah (RA) were suffering great poverty and hardship. When Hadhrat Anas (RA) took it to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Ummu Sulaym (RA) has sent this to you. She conveys Salaams to you with the message that this is a little something from us."

Rasulullaah ﷺ looked at the food and instructed Hadhrat Anas (RA) to place it in the corner of the room. Thereafter, he named a large number of people and told Hadhrat Anas (RA) to invite them all. In addition to those people, Rasulullaah ﷺ also told Hadhrat Anas (RA) to invite every other Muslim he met. Hadhrat Anas (RA) proceeded to invite the named persons as well as everyone else he met. When he returned, the room, the platform and the courtyard was full of people. When one of the narrators asked Hadhrat Anas (RA) how many people there were, he said that they were approximately three hundred.

Rasulullaah ﷺ then asked Hadhrat Anas (RA) to bring the food and when he did, Rasulullaah ﷺ placed his hand on it, made du'aa and said a few other things. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Let them sit in circles of ten, recite 'Bismillaah' and then every person should eat what is in front of him." The people then started by reciting 'Bismillaah' and ate (in turns) until all of them had eaten (to their fill). Hadhrat Anas (RA) says, "Rasulullaah ﷺ then told me to pick up the dish and when I did so and looked at it, I could not tell whether it was more when I put it down or when I picked it up."
A sweet dish prepared with dates, butter and flour.
